# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighty-five years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Green Gables, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with distinct angles and no curves. Her hair, which showed gray streaks in her middle age, eventually turned snow-white. Although she suffered from failing vision earlier in life, her eyesight surprisingly improved as she grew older.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v5 c2 P6](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0006)_

## Personality

Marilla is practical, sensible, and stern, possessing a rigid conscience and a dry sense of humor. Though stoic and reluctant to express emotion openly, she hides a soft heart and deep capacity for love behind a brusque exterior. Over time, her reserved demeanor softens through raising children, though she retains her orderly and economical nature.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016)_

- Sensible and practical  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001)</sub>
- Economical and orderly  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v4 c10 P0](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0000)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skilled at making homemade currant wine  <sub>[v1 c16 P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046)</sub>
- Making braided floor mats  <sub>[v3 c10 P1](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise and discipline Anne and later the Keith twins into proper behavior  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)</sub>
- To maintain Green Gables cleanly and efficiently  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert spent her life living at Green Gables alongside her quiet brother, Matthew. In middle age, the siblings decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, but due to a misunderstanding, Anne Shirley was sent instead; Marilla agreed to keep her and took full charge of her upbringing. Over the years, despite her initial strictness, Marilla grew deeply attached to Anne and came to view her as a daughter. Following Matthew's sudden death from heart failure, Marilla continued living at Green Gables and took in the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. She was overjoyed when Anne ultimately married Gilbert Blythe, the son of her former childhood beau John. In her old age, she welcomed Anne's children for visits at Green Gables, taking special delight in her grand-nephew Jem.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P5](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0005), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008), [v5 c3 P6](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Green Gables as a child  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Quarreled with John Blythe in her youth and refused to forgive him out of pride  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch containing her mother's hair  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Maintained a forty-five year neighborly friendship with Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>

## Quotes

> Anne is a real good plain sensible name. You’ve no need to be ashamed of it.  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020)</sub>

> Matthew and I have decided to keep you—that is, if you will try to be a good little girl and show yourself grateful.  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>

> I’m not feeling discouraged... when I make up my mind to do a thing it stays made up.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I’ve lived here for sixty years and I’ve never been on the pond yet.  <sub>[v2 c17 P73](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0073)</sub>

> When I was a child I heard an old minister say that a house was not a real home until it had been consecrated by a birth, a wedding and a death.  <sub>[v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
